title: Aye Jawaan Ali Akber Aye Haseen Ali Akber
body:
Aye jawaan Ali akber aye haseen Ali akber
Khaa gayi tumhe beta yeh zameen Ali akber
1. Dard hai kahan beta baat to karo beta
Saamne pidar ke yun aah na bharo beta
Ab shigaaf hota hai (2) dil hazeen Ali akber
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Kya sina yeh khayi hai kya sitam yeh dhayi hai
Maa ke aur Zainab ke yeh jigar me aayi hai
Ro rahi hai do maa'en (2) bar zameen Ali akber
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Haye teri madar ko chain phir na aayega
Joh na hosaki shadi gham use rulayega
Maa ki mannatoun wale (2) teh tumhi Ali akber
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Khaak hai yeh duniya per yeh bhi koi jeena hai
Tum gaye jawaan hoker yeh zaief zinda hai
Ab meri shahadat bhi (2) hai qareen Ali akber
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Dekhlo Ali akber woh mera Madina hai
Teri muntazir beta woh khadi zaiefa hai
Woh bahen teri sughra (2) nazneen Ali akber
<<DIVIDER>>
6. Ya khuda kisi ki bhi aaas na kabhi tootey
Jis tarha se sughra ke bhai hai sabhi roothey
Mujh lo lene aayeinge (2) hai yaqeen Ali akber
<<DIVIDER>>
7. Gham me sheh ke aye dawar mout ham ko pyari hai
Matam e Ali akber zindagi hamari hai
Har jawaan ke seene me (2) hai yaqeen Ali akber
Azz...dawar Ali dawar.
